description: Pahrump, NV – The Nye County Law Enforcement Association has endorsed 4th-generation Nevadan, rancher, and businessman Cody K Whipple for Congress in Nevada’s 4th Congressional District, citing his commitment to public safety, support for law enforcement, and understanding of the challenges facing Nevada communities.
